faq_heading: 1 bedroom condos in South Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: What do 1 bedroom condos sell for in South Surrey?
faq.a: Of the 1 bedroom condos in South Surrey, 43 sold over the past year at a median of $485,000, with the middle half between $448,000 and $508,500.

faq.q: How fast do 1 bedroom condos sell in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 24 days, and homes sold for 96.6% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Where in South Surrey do most 1 bedroom condos sell?
faq.a: Grandview, with 13 of the 43 sales at a median of $485,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in South Surrey have 1 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Edgewater (3 sales); Southmere Place (3 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 1 bedroom condo in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 1 bedroom condos that sold in South Surrey was $354 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.
